input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
errors: Merge conflict at merge time: PR #16675 (another session) had merged the same bible proposal under the same title while this run drafted it; the finished 5,000-word Polish draft was dropped unmerged.
git checkout -b failed because the harness had already created the branch; harmless.

doc_friction.issue: Next up often has one proposal per shelf and about 30 creative runs a day read it; nothing told a run to claim a proposal before drafting, so two sessions wrote the same story. Fixed in this PR with a 'Claim before you draft' paragraph.

'open the PR right away (draft while you work)' would have prevented the collision, but I opened it only after drafting; the creative prompt's open-PR search happens once, at the start, which is too early for a run that drafts for an hour.
Finding an unused subject for a new proposal took about ten overlap.mjs probes (snow drift, footbridge pace, flue draught all taken).

deviations.why: The run's planned deliverable (a new story) duplicated a just-merged one, so I did not land it.
deviations.did: Shipped a revision pass on the merged story (number check, one note fix), a process fix in the bible, a new proposal and a post comparing the two drafts.
deviations.result: Useful but smaller than a new story; about an hour of drafting wasted.

notes: Project: Hearth & Horizon. Piece: revision of the-gallery-that-is-full-for-the-first-time (PR #16675's story); the beam model was rebuilt from its note and every spoken figure reproduced. The dropped Polish draft is not committed. node --test 17/17. No agent doc: the bible paragraph carries the lesson.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: structural number check of a story plus a short post and bible edits

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
